_doc: Spiritual roots decide cultivation talent. Fewer elements = purer, faster root. Each element has a `description` and each grade a `blurb` (both required, <= 90 chars, shown at character creation). Final multiplier = grade.cultivation_multiplier * (0.5 + average_purity / 100).

elements.name: Metal
elements.description: Favours attack and speed: sword and finger arts, and sturdy golden shields.

elements.name: Wood
elements.description: Favours speed and defense: step arts and vine lashes, plus a hardy spring of vitality.

elements.name: Water
elements.description: Favours vitality and defense: lake and cloud methods, plus frost and reed sword arts.

elements.name: Fire
elements.description: Favours raw attack: ember and blood-lotus methods, cinder fists and thunder palms.

elements.name: Earth
elements.description: Favours defense and vitality: stone-skin and mountain body arts, and heavy fists.

grades.name: Heavenly Root
grades.blurb: One pure element: one in thirty-odd, and by far the fastest cultivation.

grades.name: Earth Root
grades.blurb: Two elements: uncommon, with swift cultivation.

grades.name: Human Root
grades.blurb: Three elements: common, a little faster than the average.

grades.name: Mixed Root
grades.blurb: Four elements: common, but slower than the average.

grades.name: Pseudo Root
grades.blurb: Five elements: common, and the slowest road to the Dao.
